newsitem.title: CHINA: SHENZHEN FIYTA GOES LIMIT UP IN AFTERNOON.
newsitem.headline: SHENZHEN FIYTA GOES LIMIT UP IN AFTERNOON.

text.p: China's Shenzhen Fiyta Holdings Ltd's hard currency B shares rose HK$0.56 or its 10 percent daily limit up to HK$6.16 in early Tuesday afternoon trading in Shenzhen after announcing strong 1997 interim results, brokers said.
"Investors are snapping up Fiyta after the company posted strong interim results," said an analyst at J&A Securities.
Fiyta on Tuesday reported an 85 percent year-on-year surge in its 1997 first half net profit to 48.55 million yuan based on Chinese accounting standards.
Based on international standards, the company posted net earnings of 45.79 million yuan in the first six months of this year. It gave no comparative figure.
Fiyta registered trading volume of 199,469 shares valued at HK$1.23 million in early afternoon trading.
